actions.name: Send chat message
actions.description: Publish a message to Twitch chat on the broadcaster channel.

schema.label: Message
schema.description: Plain text. Twitch chat enforces a 500-character limit.
schema.hint: Supports template substitution from the trigger event (e.g. {user.name}).

actions.name: Shoutout
actions.description: Send a Twitch shoutout for another channel, the same one the /shoutout chat command sends. Fails the step when Twitch refuses, unless the refusal is a rate limit and skipping is turned on.

schema.label: Channel
schema.description: The channel to shout out. A numeric user id is used as-is; anything else is resolved as a login name.
schema.hint: Supports template substitution, so a raid trigger can pass its raider straight through.

schema.label: Skip when rate limited
schema.description: Succeed without a shoutout instead of failing the step when Twitch's shoutout rate limit is hit.
schema.hint: Twitch allows one shoutout every 2 minutes and one per channel every 60 minutes, so back-to-back raids often hit the limit. Turn this on to let the rest of the workflow run anyway; the step's skipped output says whether it happened.

fields.description: The Twitch user id of the channel that was shouted out. Absent when skipped.
Whether the shoutout was skipped because of Twitch's rate limit.

actions.name: Create clip
actions.description: Clip the last moments of the live stream, the same as the Clip button on Twitch.

fields.description: The clip's id.
Where the clip can be viewed and edited.

actions.name: Place stream marker
actions.description: Drop a stream marker at the current point of the live stream, to find the moment again in the VOD.

schema.label: Description
schema.description: Optional note shown next to the marker in the VOD. Twitch allows up to 140 characters.
schema.hint: Supports template substitution, e.g. a hype train's level. Twitch only places markers while the stream is live.

fields.description: The marker's id.
When the marker was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
The marker's description.
How far into the stream the marker sits, in seconds.

actions.name: Update stream info
actions.description: Change the stream's title, category or tags. Blank fields are left as they are.

schema.label: Title
schema.placeholder: Leave blank to keep the current title
schema.description: The new stream title. Twitch allows up to 140 characters.
schema.hint: Supports template substitution, so a chat command can pass what the chatter typed.

schema.label: Category
schema.description: A game or category name. The closest match on Twitch is used: an exact name wins, otherwise the most relevant search result.

schema.label: Tags
schema.description: Comma-separated. Replaces all of the stream's tags. Twitch allows up to 10 tags of letters and numbers, 25 characters each.

fields.description: The title that was set. Absent when unchanged.
The id of the category that was set. Absent when unchanged.
The name of the category the text resolved to. Absent when unchanged.
The tags that were set. Absent when unchanged.

actions.name: Time out chatter
actions.description: Time a chatter out of Twitch chat, the same as the /timeout chat command.

schema.label: Chatter
schema.description: The chatter to time out. A numeric user id is used as-is; anything else is resolved as a login name.
schema.hint: Supports template substitution, so a chat trigger can pass its chatter's id straight through.

schema.label: Duration
schema.description: How long the timeout lasts. Twitch allows 1 second to 2 weeks.

schema.label: Reason
schema.description: Shown to the chatter and in the moderation log.

fields.description: The Twitch user id of the chatter who was timed out.
How long the timeout lasts, in seconds.
